verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a financial-data API service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any region or residency selection for Financial Connections data. Community remarks that the product is 'only available in the US' concern bank and market coverage, not where data is stored, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
